svg.title: Worker receiving a long object - left rear view
svg.desc: Construction worker viewed from the left rear, standing with both arms extended and open gloved hands ready to receive a long object. The worker wears a helmet, full-body harness, work clothes and safety boots. Worker only; object omitted.
svg.metadata: id: W011 name_ja: 長尺物受取作業員（左後方） file: worker_receiving_object_left_rear.svg category: 作業員 view: left rear tool: none source: user-provided reference image repository: Ryujiiwaizumi/construction-pictograms
